_about: Store category and one-line description of each app (tools/make_apps_release.py adds them to apps.json). category: emulators, games, tools, productivity or education. description: at most 120 characters.

emu.a800.description: Atari 800 and 5200 games, disks and tapes from /sd/roms/a800

emu.col.description: ColecoVision games (.col) from /sd/roms/col; needs BIOS.col there too

emu.gba.description: Game Boy Advance games (.gba) from /sd/roms/gba (gpSP with a RISC-V JIT; optional gba_bios.bin there)

emu.genesis.description: Sega Genesis / Mega Drive games (.md, .gen, .bin) from /sd/roms/gen

emu.neogeo.description: Neo Geo games (.zip) from /sd/roms/neogeo; needs the neogeo.zip BIOS

game.doom.description: The classic shooter (PrBoom). Needs a WAD in /sd/roms/doom, e.g. the shareware doom1.wad

game.duke3d.description: Duke Nukem 3D (Chocolate Duke3D). Needs DUKE3D.GRP in /sd/roms/duke3d

game.opentyrian.description: Vertical shoot 'em up. Needs the free Tyrian 2.1 data in /sd/tyrian/data

game.quake.description: id Software's Quake. Needs id1/pak0.pak in /sd/roms/quake (shareware works)

tool.clock.description: Clock, alarms, stopwatch, timer and world clock; touch or pad

tool.files.description: File manager for the SD card: browse, copy, move, rename and delete
